memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Gout
  - Status: First presentation, painful right first MTP joint swelling 2 days, serum uric acid pending.
  - Plan: Order serum uric acid and creatinine, start allopurinol 100 mg OD after food, advise low‑purine diet, weight 68 kg, waist 88 cm (female cut‑off 80 cm).
- Weight
  - Status: 68 kg, waist 88 cm (>80 cm).
  - Plan: Diet advice – Breakfast: idli with sambar, avoid sugary tea; Lunch: mixed vegetable roti with dal, limit red meat; Dinner: grilled fish with steamed vegetables, avoid fried snacks.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum uric acid: 8.2 mg/dL (Reference 2.4‑6.0).
Serum creatinine: 0.9 mg/dL (Reference 0.6‑1.1).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Gout
  - Status: No flare since starting allopurinol, uric acid down to 5.8 mg/dL, creatinine stable.
  - Plan: Continue allopurinol 100 mg OD, recheck labs in 3 months, reinforce low‑purine diet, weight 67 kg, waist 86 cm (>80 cm).
- Weight
  - Status: 67 kg, waist 86 cm (>80 cm).
  - Plan: Diet advice – Breakfast: oats with milk, no added sugar; Lunch: quinoa salad with chickpeas, limit shellfish; Dinner: chicken stir‑fry with broccoli, avoid organ meats.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum uric acid: 5.8 mg/dL (Reference 2.4‑6.0).
Serum creatinine: 0.9 mg/dL (Reference 0.6‑1.1).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I have had mild pain in my left big toe for the past two days, worse after walking. I think it might be a gout flare. Can I get something for the pain?

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Gout
  - Status: Acute flare of left first MTP joint, erythema and swelling, serum uric acid 6.2 mg/dL (still within target).
  - Plan: Add colchicine 0.5 mg BD for 5 days, continue allopurinol 200 mg OD, advise rest and ice, weight 66.5 kg, waist 85 cm (>80 cm).
- Weight
  - Status: 66.5 kg, waist 85 cm (>80 cm).
  - Plan: Diet advice – Breakfast: vegetable upma, avoid sugary juice; Lunch: brown rice with lentils, limit anchovies; Dinner: paneer bhurji with capsicum, avoid gravy rich in purines.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Colchicine 0.5 mg, 1-0-1, after food, for 5 days.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2026-02-20 at 10:30 AM with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Gout
  - Status: No flares in past 6 months, uric acid 5.4 mg/dL within target, creatinine stable.
  - Plan: Continue allopurinol 200 mg OD, repeat labs in 3 months, maintain low‑purine diet, weight 66 kg, waist 84 cm (>80 cm).
- Weight
  - Status: 66 kg, waist 84 cm (>80 cm).
  - Plan: Diet advice – Breakfast: millet porridge with nuts, avoid sweetened yogurt; Lunch: mixed vegetable khichdi, limit sardines; Dinner: grilled chicken with salad, avoid broth‑based soups.
